name: ruTorrent
description: ruTorrent is a front-end for the popular BitTorrent client rTorrent. It provides a clean web interface with plugin support for managing torrents, monitoring download progress, and automating tasks via RSS feeds and watch directories.

notes.text: Some ruTorrent plugins (spectrogram, screenshots, dumptorrent) require optional binaries (sox, ffmpeg, dumptorrent) that are not installed by default.
HTTP Basic authentication uses port 80 by default. Use HTTPS before exposing ruTorrent to an untrusted network.
